entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.4xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51913
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #51912
  • [Analyzers][C#14.0]Raise a notification when an extension method call is redirected to a Span/ReadOnlySpan method #51904
  • `dotnet reference add` can't find project in current directory #51897
  • ResolvePackageFileConflicts crashes when any items have { in the path #51896

Closed

  • Jupyter is not available in dotnet 6.0, broken with dotnet 3.1 install #27976
  • .Net MAUI issue in the first time usage. #27885
  • Some project dependencies are not being built into bin folder when I add aspnetcore framework as a reference into another project (dependent projects) #30682
  • dotnet build error MSB4115 - NET SDK 6.0.4 and further #30683
  • .NET tool installation consumes much more disk space than necessary #27502
  • [Bug] Installed Custom Sdks in DOTNET_ROOT/packs now cant be located for loading in Visual Studio. #27329
  • `dotnet new sln` is not using templates from the right version #51669
  • Install of dotnet sdk 10 debian package warns about needing an excessively large size (652 GB) #51899
  • dotnet project convert add `UserSecretsId` config #51862
  • CA1873 potential false positive for non-expensive logging parameters #51903
  • global.json template: add `--test-runner` option #50753
    10.0.1xx
  • `dotnet test` does not ignore projects marked as `<IsTestProject>false</IsTestProject>` with Microsoft.Testing.Platform #51873
  • `dotnet test --solution` fails to resole path with backslash in solution filter on Linux #51521
  • Debian 13 packages show unsatisified dependency on netstandard, not installable #51744
